property_summary: For any attacker-deployer address A and any deposited amount v>0, if A deposits v and then calls withdraw, then after withdraw completes the contract's ETH balance equals its prior balance minus v (i.e., the contract sends out exactly v for that depositor); the mutant allows a reentrant attacker to cause the contract to send out more than v so this equality can be violated.
change_summary: Move the zeroing of the caller's balance to after the external call (prevents resetting balance before sending, enabling potential reentrancy to withdraw multiple times).
